## Purpose and completion criteria

Assess whether the constant-rate mortality and fertility simulator reproduces
the supplied demographic schedules adequately for milestone 1.

**To complete:** specify the comparisons and acceptable differences before
interpreting results. Distinguish systematic bias, variability between runs,
and uncertainty in the estimated mean. Record any exploratory analyses.

| Measure | Comparison | Acceptance criterion |
|---|---|---|
| ASFR | Output births / female exposure versus input rates | To specify |
| TFR | Output versus input TFR over matched ages | To specify |
| ASMR | Output deaths / exposure versus input rates, by sex | To specify |
| Life expectancy | Output versus input-derived life table | To specify |
| Birth spacing and accounting | Existing tests and checks on simulated histories | To specify |

## Inputs and simulation design

The starter settings below follow `inst/examples/milestone1_bootstrap.R`.
They are editable analysis settings, not accepted accuracy thresholds.

```{r}
#| label: setup
devtools::load_all("..", quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

country <- "USA"
rate_year <- 2000
start_time <- 2000
years <- 100
end_time <- start_time + years
population_size <- 100000
max_age <- 100
birth_interval <- 0.75
population_seed <- 42
replication_seeds <- seq_len(100)

mortality_path <- file.path("data", "mortality-USA-2000.rds")
fertility_path <- file.path("data", "fertility-USA-2000.rds")
```

### Prepare and preserve inputs

Run this chunk manually once if needed. It remains disabled during rendering,
even when execution is enabled for the rest of the report. Downloads require
HMDHFDplus and configured HMD/HFD credentials. Save rate tables, not credentials.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-inputs
#| eval: false
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(get_mortality_hmd(country, rate_year), mortality_path)
saveRDS(get_fertility_hfd(country, rate_year), fertility_path)
```

```{r}
#| label: input-schedules
mortality_rates <- readRDS(mortality_path)
fertility_rates <- readRDS(fertility_path)

attr(mortality_rates, "source")
attr(fertility_rates, "source")
tools::md5sum(c(mortality_path, fertility_path))

input_tfr <- calculate_tfr(fertility_rates)
input_life_table <- calculate_life_table(mortality_rates)
input_life_expectancy <- input_life_table |>
  filter(age_start == 0) |>
  select(sex, ex)

input_tfr
input_life_expectancy
```

**To complete:** describe the source revision and retained fertility ages.
HFD open-ended fertility rows are omitted, so the reference TFR excludes their
contributions. Mortality central rates are interpreted as piecewise constant
hazards; the reference life table uses that same interpretation.

### Initialization and observation windows

All replications below share one baseline population. They measure simulation
variability conditional on that population. Baseline-generation variability
would require a separate design.

**To complete:** choose the burn-in/observation policy and explain treatment of
the initial fertility transient. The baseline is not claimed to be stable or
historically representative. Midpoint fertility compensation does not calibrate
initial reproductive histories.

```{r}
#| label: construct-model
set.seed(population_seed)
population <- create_baseline_population(
  population_size, max_age = max_age, end_time = start_time
)
model <- hammel_model() |>
  set_population(population) |>
  set_mortality(mortality_rates) |>
  set_fertility(fertility_rates, birth_interval = birth_interval)

fertility_time_breaks <- c(
  seq(start_time, start_time + 9, 1),
  seq(start_time + 10, end_time, 10)
)
mortality_time_breaks <- seq(start_time, end_time, 20)
# Finite last breakpoints automatically gain an open interval.
life_table_age_breaks <- 0:100
mortality_age_breaks <- 0:110
fertility_age_breaks <- sort(unique(c(
  0, fertility_rates$age_start, fertility_rates$age_end
)))
```

## Replications and demographic extraction

```{r}
#| label: run-replications
results <- map(replication_seeds, function(seed) {
  simulate(model, years = years, seed = seed)
})
names(results) <- as.character(replication_seeds)

fertility_counts <- map(results, calculate_lexis_counts,
  time_breaks = fertility_time_breaks,
  age_breaks = fertility_age_breaks)
mortality_counts <- map(results, calculate_lexis_counts,
  time_breaks = mortality_time_breaks,
  age_breaks = mortality_age_breaks)
life_table_counts <- map(results, calculate_lexis_counts,
  time_breaks = fertility_time_breaks,
  age_breaks = life_table_age_breaks)

tfr <- map(fertility_counts, calculate_tfr) |>
  bind_rows(.id = "replication")
asfr <- bind_rows(fertility_counts, .id = "replication") |>
  filter(sex == "f")
asmr <- bind_rows(mortality_counts, .id = "replication")
life_expectancy <- map(life_table_counts, calculate_life_table) |>
  bind_rows(.id = "replication") |>
  filter(age_start == 0)
```
